ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity pixels; estimated macro-level ratio of 98:2 (black-to-white) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid black pigmentation dominates the entire surface. High-intensity white pixel clusters are localized exclusively at the distal tips and in sparse, thin linear streaks across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an acute angle of approximately 35 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 1/6th of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical serration pattern; left lobe trailing edge features 4-5 prominent jagged peaks (~15-30 pixels), while the right lobe features higher-frequency, lower-amplitude (~5-10 pixels) saw-tooth serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep along the leading edges, terminating in sharply tapered, upward-curved distal tips (concave transition at the terminals).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed white pixel clusters forming circular rosette shapes at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple faint, unaligned light-grey linear streaks detected; notably one diagonal mark (~50 pixels) on the left lobe and several shorter vertical marks on the inner right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant white scarring and irregular pixel textures concentrated at the distal tips and along specific segments of the trailing edge, suggesting historical tissue loss or heavy barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct horizontal ridge-like banding and high-contrast white pixel highlights at the base of the fluke near the peduncle insertion.
